exams.name: Electrical Administrator Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Tests knowledge of plans, design specifications, electrical installations and wiring, National Electrical Code, National Electrical Safety Code, and other ANSI-approved standards. May be waived if applicant holds equivalent out-of-state license and has passed equivalent examination.
exams.quote: A licensing examination shall be offered by the department at least twice during each year at appropriate places in the state.

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be renewed biennially on the dates set by the department with the approval of the respective board.

required.quote: relating to the examination and licensing of electrical administrators and the establishing of the continued competency of an applicant for license renewal and reinstatement.

available.quote: If an applicant for a license submits proof satisfactory to the department that the applicant is licensed as an electrical administrator or the equivalent by another state or territory, that the applicant meets qualifications established by the department under AS 08.40.045, and that the applicant has passed an examination equivalent to the test administered under (a) of this section, the department shall waive all of the examination required under (a) of this section.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold equivalent license from another state or territory, meet Alaska qualification standards, and have passed an equivalent examination; upon proof, the department waives the Alaska examination.

definition_quote.value: "electrical administrator" means a person who is responsible for (A) installing or repairing electrical wiring, conduits, devices, fixtures, equipment, or other electrical materials for transmitting, using, or consuming electrical energy; or (B) certifying that an installation or repair described in (A) of this paragraph complies with applicable electrical codes

scope__license_tiers.quote: The department may adopt regulations establishing categories of electrical administrators, qualifications for those categories, and the content of examinations for applicants for each category.

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Electric utility generation, transmission, and distribution work
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: AS 08.40.005 - 08.40.200 do not apply to any utility or municipality engaged in (1) electrical construction and maintenance of electrical wiring for the generation and distribution of electrical current where the wiring is an integral part of a system owned and operated by that utility or municipal light and power department

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Telephone, signal, and communications system work by utility employees
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: the installation, operation, maintenance, or repair of telephone, signal, or communication systems when the work is performed by the employees of that utility

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Low-voltage signaling, fire alarm, and intrusion alarm systems
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: the installation, maintenance, and repair of fire alarm, intrusion alarm, or other low voltage signaling systems of 48 volts to ground or less

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Manufacture and repair of electrical apparatus or equipment
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: the manufacture, maintenance, or repair of electrical apparatus or equipment

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Homeowner electrical work on owner-occupied residential property
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: electrical installation on residential property that is owned by the installer or a member of the installer's immediate family and not intended for sale at the time of making the installation

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Television and radio broadcasting system operation, maintenance, and installation
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: the operation, maintenance, or repair of a television or radio broadcasting system and the installation of a radio broadcasting system under 500 watts input power except for A.C. power supply and wiring

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Elevator control system installation, maintenance, and repair
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: the installation, maintenance, and repair of elevators so long as the work is performed by an agent or employee of the elevator industry and is confined to the elevator control system

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Diesel electric engine maintenance and repair on heavy construction equipment
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: the maintenance or repair of diesel electric engines installed on heavy construction equipment, either in a shop or on a job site

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Water well submersible pump motor and wiring installation
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: the installation in a commercial water well of the submersible pump motor and the wiring to the well pump system controls if the controls are outside a building or a structure

scope__scope_exclusions.item: In-house electrical maintenance and repair by employees of commercial property owner or tenant
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: electrical maintenance or repair work if the work is performed by the person as an employee of an owner or tenant of commercial property as part of the employee's work duties with respect to the property but is not offered or performed as a service to the public

scope__scope_exclusions.item: CATV and cable television technician work
Direct broadcast satellite and satellite antenna system installation
Appliance sales, installation, and repair by retail merchants or utility employees
Industrial facility electrical work (manufacturing, processing, and related facilities)
Nonresidential farm building electrical work
HVACR licensee running line voltage wiring to HVAC equipment
Alarm system installation, maintenance, and servicing by licensed alarm company
Work by employees receiving wages as sole compensation (not in independent business)
Petroleum and gas well drilling and operation
Work by government officers, agencies, or authorized representatives
Minor or casual work below a monetary threshold
scope__scope_exclusions.quote: electrical work, the cost of which does not exceed $5,000, involving residences or small commercial establishments in communities that (A) have a population of under 500 according to the latest available federal or state census or other census approved by the department; or (B) are over 50 miles by air or water transportation from the business place of an electrical administrator

scope__scope_exclusions.item: Modular and manufactured housing construction
Licensed architect or engineer acting within professional capacity
Work on personal property (not affixed to structure)
Irrigation, drainage, and agricultural district construction and maintenance
Material supplier or manufacturer furnishing materials without installation
Subsurface utility location and designation services
Condominium, apartment, or cooperative unit owner or management agent repair and maintenance
Gas, propane, and fuel gas equipment connection work
Mural and public art installation by licensed artists
